sloka: लङ्कां चेयं पुरी रम्या सवाजिरथकुञ्जरा ।सागरे पतिता दृष्टा भग्नगोपुरतोरणा ।। ५.२७.३५।।।।
transliteration: laṅkāṁ ceyaṁ purī ramyā savājirathakuñjarā ।sāgare patitā dṛṣṭā bhagnagopuratoraṇā ।। 5.27.35।।।।

translations.english: "I saw this delightful Lanka teeming with horses, chariots and elephants, archways and towers crumbling and falling into the ocean.
